kind: Predeclared stronger-model ladder: lower-memory two-bit candidate resource diagnostic

candidate.integrity: All three pinned weight shards checked against publisher SHA256 after download.
candidate.runtime: Isolated oMLX 0.7.0, sole model, 49,152 backend/agent context, 8,192 output, Fast Agent, 27 GiB process guard, full browser/search tools.

policy.preflight: Three green idle samples before each prompt
policy.abort: Two host warning samples, missing telemetry, or >512 MiB swap growth; no guard relaxation

runs.guard_result: Sustained host memory warning after model-loaded coding and browser work; controlled interrupt, owned session idle. Sampled swap growth 0; peak sampled listener physical footprint 16,647,626,024 bytes.
runs.post_abort_independent_diagnostic: Source/API, existing tests, JS syntax and diff hygiene passed. Task06 browser 503 retry and Cancel Edit browser failed. Workspace was interrupted before a settled autonomous completion; this is not an acceptance verdict.

runs.guard_result: Warm model again reached sustained host memory warning; controlled interrupt, owned session idle. Sampled swap growth 0; peak sampled listener physical footprint 16,042,761,488 bytes.
runs.post_abort_independent_diagnostic: Source/API, existing tests, JS syntax and diff hygiene passed. Task06 stored-markup and Cancel Edit browser flows failed. Workspace was interrupted before a settled autonomous completion; this is not an acceptance verdict.

invocation_correction: An initial trial invocation mistakenly supplied prompt text instead of the required prompt file path and failed before inference; the same untouched fixture was then used with a new stage controller-q2-01a. The failed invocation is archived, not counted as a model trial.
third_repetition: Not attempted while host warnings recurred on both fresh guarded runs. Three settled matched quality repetitions remain unmet.
owner_restore: Private server terminated and unloaded the candidate. Owner settings SHA256 matched the pretrial snapshot; kryn bench passed guarded local protocol; kryn doctor --deep verified every pinned model and browser dependency, healthy 9B/96K/22 GiB runtime, connected browser/search and normal pressure. Disposable SSD cache removed after archiving raw evidence; model weights retained privately for a later green-host retry.
decision: No quality ranking or promotion. The same occupied host also resource-gated two-bit inference. Retry only after memory headroom changes; keep daily 9B installed and public releases paused.
